# ND Electronic Technologies Ltd

> Integrated systems installer based in Lukuli, Nanganda (Makindye Division), Kampala, Uganda. Supplies and installs CCTV cameras, solar power & renewable energy, carports & carshades, fire suppression, electric & laser fencing, alarm systems, gate automation, access control, air conditioning, network installation & support, internet connectivity (Starlink/fiber/VSAT/microwave), and electrical engineering — for homes, businesses and institutions. Runs an online shop for related equipment.

ND Electronic Technologies Ltd is a single-contractor alternative to hiring separate specialists for security, energy, structural, fire-safety, connectivity and electrical work. Every project starts with a free, no-obligation site survey, followed by a system design and quotation before any commitment. The company is locally based and serves Kampala, Makindye, Wakiso, Mukono, Entebbe Road and nearby districts.

## Company details
- Legal name: ND Electronic Technologies Ltd
- Address: BNK Building, 2nd Floor, Lukuli–Nanganda Road, Makindye Division, Kampala, Uganda

- Hours: Monday–Friday 8:00–18:00, Saturday 9:00–16:00, closed Sunday
- Service area: Kampala and surrounding districts (Makindye, Wakiso, Mukono, Entebbe Road)

## Services
- [CCTV Cameras](https://ndelectronictechnologies.com/services/cctv-cameras/): HD/4K IP and analog camera systems, remote mobile/web viewing, night vision, motion detection, NVR/DVR setup and storage.
- [Solar Power & Renewable Energy](https://ndelectronictechnologies.com/services/solar-power/): Grid-tied and off-grid solar systems, battery backup and inverter setup, load assessment and sizing, panel servicing.
- [Carshades & Carports](https://ndelectronictechnologies.com/services/carports-carshades/): Steel-frame carports and shade structures, custom sized, solar-ready, powder-coated finishes.
- [Electric & Laser Fencing](https://ndelectronictechnologies.com/services/electric-fencing/): Electric fence strand installation, laser wire boundary detection, energizer supply and earthing.
- [Alarm Systems](https://ndelectronictechnologies.com/services/alarm-systems/): Door, window and motion sensors, control panel and keypad installation, integration with CCTV and access control.
- [Gate Automation](https://ndelectronictechnologies.com/services/gate-automation/): Sliding and swing gate motor installation, remotes and keypad access, intercom integration.
- [Access Control](https://ndelectronictechnologies.com/services/access-control/): Card, fob, PIN and biometric (fingerprint) access for doors and gates, visitor/staff access logs.
- [Air Conditioning](https://ndelectronictechnologies.com/services/air-conditioning/): Split and ducted AC supply, installation, sizing, servicing and gas top-up.
- [Fire Suppression Systems](https://ndelectronictechnologies.com/services/fire-suppression/): Detection and suppression systems, sprinklers, extinguisher supply and servicing, scheduled inspection.
- [Network Installation & Support](https://ndelectronictechnologies.com/services/network-installation/): Structured cabling, LAN/WAN setup, Wi-Fi design, router/switch configuration, ongoing IT support.
- [Internet & Connectivity](https://ndelectronictechnologies.com/services/internet-connectivity/): Starlink installation, fiber optic splicing, microwave links, VSAT satellite internet.
- [Electrical Engineering](https://ndelectronictechnologies.com/services/electrical-engineering/): Residential and commercial wiring, installation, fault-finding, panel and distribution board work.
